# Data Integrity & Sync Idempotency Checklist: Idempotent Cloud Synchronization & Database Deduplication

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, natural-key completeness, and edge-case coverage for database deduplication and idempotent cloud synchronization
**Created**: 2026-11-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are natural identity keys explicitly defined for all synced and local entity types (`CycleGoal`, `Exercise`, `Routine`, `Session`, `RepMax`, `Cycle`, `WeightEntry`, `DailyLog`)? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §1-7]
- [x] CHK002 Are automatic trigger points for database deduplication specified across app startup, pre-upload, and post-download lifecycles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are foreign-key and relational remapping rules specified before deleting duplicate parent entities (`Exercise`, `Routine`, `Cycle`, `Session`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Consistency

- [x] CHK004 Is the tie-breaking rule for selecting the canonical `CycleGoal` row from a duplicate group unambiguous and order-preserving? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §3]
- [x] CHK005 Does the `CycleGoal` natural key distinguish adaptive metric goals (`WEIGHT`, `CALORIES`, `REPS`) on the same movement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are repository-level upsert semantics consistent with cloud-sync download upsert semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-010]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are requirements specified for handling remote `cycleId` values that do not match local `Cycle` IDs? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements specified for handling cross-device `exerciseId` drift via normalized `exerciseName` resolution? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for deduplicating a remote cloud payload that itself contains duplicate items in its `list` array? [Coverage, Spec §US2.2, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Are concurrency requirements specified when multiple synchronization requests overlap (e.g., sign-in restore + manual sync)? [Coverage, Spec §US2.3, §FR-011]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [x] CHK011 Is the cleanup of the 64 duplicated cycle goals (`Front Squat 3RM` and `Snatch 2RM`) quantified with an exact target outcome (`2` unique goals, `0` duplicates)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK012 Is repeated manual synchronization (`Sync Now` `N >= 5` times) quantified with `0` additional duplicate rows across all collections? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Notes

- All 12 requirements-quality criteria audited against `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/sync-deduplication-contract.md` and verified satisfied (`12/12`).
